HomePage.seoIntroTitle: Taxi work in Poland with a ready-to-work car
HomePage.seoIntroText1: Vonco Partners helps drivers start taxi work in Poland quickly and legally. We match the vehicle, explain cooperation terms, help with documents, and onboard drivers to Uber, Bolt, and Free Now.
HomePage.seoIntroText2: Drivers can choose taxi car rental, daily rental, work with their own car, or a lease-to-own program. We match the cooperation model to the city, schedule, experience, and long-term goals.
HomePage.faqTitle: Frequently asked questions about taxi work and car rental

faq.q1: Can I start without my own car?
faq.a1: Yes. We provide vehicles prepared for Uber, Bolt, and Free Now, so a driver can start without buying a car.
faq.a2: Yes. Daily rental is useful if you want to test the work model or need a car for a short period.
faq.a3: Yes. For long-term cooperation, lease-to-own programs are available with individual terms.
faq.q4: Can I work with my own car?
faq.a4: Yes. We help check platform requirements, prepare documents, and organize onboarding.
faq.a5: Yes. We explain the required steps and help with formalities, legalization, platform onboarding, and taximeter setup.
faq.q6: Is there support after I start?
faq.a6: Yes. A manager supports drivers with daily work topics: platforms, schedule, vehicle, service, and organization.

car.title: Car for work
car.desc: A taxi-ready vehicle that can be used for work and personal trips.
car.fullDetails: You receive a taxi-ready vehicle with the required licence. The deposit equals one week of rent. The vehicle owner covers scheduled maintenance and repairs included in the agreement, while the driver is responsible for proper use, new damage, tyre damage, and agreed consumables. The car can be used for work and personal trips.

krakow.name: Krakow
krakow.demandText: Krakow is one of the strongest taxi markets in Poland. Airport transfers, tourism, office districts, universities and active evening traffic create steady year-round demand.
krakow.seoText: Taxi driver work in Krakow is suitable for drivers who want to combine city rides, airport transfers and tourism routes. Vonco Partners helps with Uber, Bolt and Free Now onboarding, taxi car rental or verification of your own vehicle.
krakow.earningsText: Estimated gross monthly income for a taxi driver in Krakow: 7,000-12,000 PLN, depending on schedule, season, platform mix, driving hours and costs.
krakow.hotspots: Kraków Główny, Old Town, Kazimierz, Balice Airport, office districts
krakow.districts: Podgórze, Nowa Huta, Krowodrza, Prądnik Czerwony, Bronowice
krakow.fleetFocus: economical hybrid city cars and comfort sedans for longer routes

katowice.name: Katowice
katowice.demandText: Katowice and the Silesian metro area create steady demand through intercity routes, office centers, events, shopping areas and airport transfers.
katowice.seoText: Taxi driver work in Katowice is a strong option for drivers who want access to the wider Silesian metropolitan area, not only one city. We help with platform onboarding, taxi car rental and document support.
katowice.earningsText: Estimated gross monthly income for a taxi driver in Katowice: 6,500-11,000 PLN, depending on schedule, route mix, platform and cooperation model.
katowice.hotspots: PKP Katowice, Silesia City Center, Spodek, office centers, Pyrzowice transfers
katowice.districts: Ligota, Koszutka, Bogucice, Zaleze, Katowice city center

zakopane.name: Zakopane
zakopane.demandText: Zakopane has strong seasonal taxi demand. Weekends, holidays, winter season and tourism-heavy periods increase trips between hotels, stations and popular locations.
zakopane.seoText: Taxi driver work in Zakopane is suitable for drivers ready for seasonal demand, tourist routes and transfers. Vonco Partners helps choose a car suitable for city driving, mountain conditions and winter season.
zakopane.earningsText: Estimated gross monthly income for a taxi driver in Zakopane: 6,000-13,000 PLN, usually higher during peak tourism season.
zakopane.hotspots: Krupówki, bus station, hotel zones, Gubałówka transfers, Kościelisko direction
zakopane.districts: Krupówki area, Olcza, Harenda, Kuźnice, Kościelisko direction
zakopane.fleetFocus: compact, reliable cars prepared for winter conditions

gdansk.name: Gdansk
gdansk.demandText: Gdańsk is part of the shared Tricity work area together with Gdynia and Sopot. Uber and Bolt drivers can accept bookings across the area without switching cities, while Bolt's official coverage also includes several nearby towns.
gdansk.seoText: Driving in Gdańsk covers Gdańsk, Gdynia, and Sopot as one Tricity region for Uber and Bolt. Vonco Partners helps drivers choose a car, prepare documents, and activate an account for the region. Free Now officially lists Gdańsk, so availability across the rest of Tricity should be confirmed with a manager.
gdansk.earningsText: Estimated gross monthly income for a taxi driver in Gdansk: 6,800-11,500 PLN, depending on schedule, season, platform and route profile.
gdansk.hotspots: Gdańsk Airport, Gdańsk Główny, the Old Town, Wrzeszcz, central Sopot, Gdynia port and railway station
gdansk.districts: Gdańsk, Gdynia, Sopot, and routes to Pruszcz Gdański, Rumia, Reda, and Wejherowo
gdansk.fleetFocus: hybrid cars for city, tourism and airport routes

uber.fitText: Uber is a strong option for city rides, airport transfers and predictable demand during peak hours.

bolt.fitText: Bolt works well as a main or additional platform for flexible city driving.

freenow.fitText: Free Now complements other platforms and can help increase order flow in larger cities.
